learner_operation: Infer two elementary column additions that create two zeros in one row of a 3x3 matrix, using a specified unchanged pivot column. Calculate each multiplier and check the whole column, rather than infer a key from answer-bank multiplicities.

fixed_features.feature: 3x3 matrix, specified unchanged pivot column, two column additions
fixed_features.justification: All ten questions and canonical e-8051 assess this operation and workload.

fixed_features.feature: Nonzero pivot and two nonzero integer multipliers
fixed_features.justification: Two nontrivial exact-integer eliminations preserve the observed easy skill and avoid ambiguity/no-op distractors.

fixed_features.feature: Five radio choices, exactly one correct pair
fixed_features.justification: Observed response contract in every source practice bank.

answer_roles.role: Which pair in a recognizable bank is correct
answer_roles.eligible_variation: All five entries can qualify when matching target-row evidence changes.
answer_roles.observed: 45 controlled records: each of nine fixed banks admits all five keys, before and after delivery.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: All three columns and rows; B and solution must follow.
answer_roles.observed: Nine explicit assignments plus same-A pivot counterfactual.

answer_roles.role: Signs, multiplier magnitudes and background entries
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Positive/negative exact integer operations with comparable arithmetic. Background entries do not determine multipliers.
answer_roles.observed: Fresh sample covers all four sign patterns; relevant and irrelevant pairs update or preserve response appropriately.

coverage.result: Strict original test fails on old generator and passes on revision; isolated author preflight also passes.
All five correct positions for each of nine complete fixed banks survive normalization and deduplication.

coverage.case: Fresh runtime and actual runner batch
coverage.result: 72 fresh records and exact five batch records; batch contains varied signs, rows, pivot columns and key positions, not sign-only repeats.

counterfactuals.change: A[0][0] 4 -> -4 with same pivot 2, same answer bank and remaining A entries.
counterfactuals.expected: First multiplier -2 -> +2; B, intermediate matrix, conclusion and grading change.
counterfactuals.observed: Native grade accepts new pair and rejects old pair. Exact visible-matrix checks and render/question-006.png vs 007 confirm changed prompt and solution.
counterfactuals.justification: k=-a_ri/a_rp from source e-8051 and q-91189.

counterfactuals.change: Off-target A[1][0] 1 -> 8, with target row unchanged.
counterfactuals.expected: Operation pair preserved; corresponding B and worked-stage entries update.

counterfactuals.justification: Off-target entries do not change elimination multipliers; full-column application still changes them.

counterfactuals.expected: Target column labels, zeroed columns, B and explanation follow pivot.

stages_examined: source-shaped bank eligibility before uniform key selection
shared publisher normalization and identity validation
fresh practice eligibility and weighted/history-dependent selection
delivery.result: 131/131 independent runtime records and 5/5 exact batch records survive. Frequency counts unchanged by delivery. Bank/key retained across forced matrix retry; all 45 controlled role cases survive. Positive easy weight leaves all eligible records selectable; learner history can exclude seen/reserved records. No preparation.json exists, so shared read-only preparation was used at captured basis 5581.

limitations: Finite, targeted audit does not establish absence of every conceivable shortcut.
Only captured inventory basis 5581 examined; all ten entries are original sources, with zero generated historical records.
Future entity IDs, actual learner histories and changing live inventory cannot be predicted; selection rule tested with synthetic increasing IDs.
One batch item happens to satisfy the earlier predictor. Counterexamples within identical banks disprove a reliable generator-wide cue; the predictor cannot answer the other four batch records.
